mass_model.note: composite tubes shave ~0.13 kg vs the Phase 1 fiberglass model; fins unchanged (already molded CFRP); warhead bay unchanged

launch_shock.budget: 3x motor initial acceleration on the fin set and canards, per MIL-STD-810 method 516 style shock budgets

vibration.budget: random vibration 20-2000 Hz per MIL-STD-810 method 514 style; canard servos must hold position under the burnout dynamic load

storage_temperature.budget: MIL-STD-810 method 503 style storage; motor, spring, and electronics rated over the range; PLA+ parts are superseded (MIL-DEV-007) precisely because they leave this window

basis: bisection sizing on the CEP drag model; no motor has been built or static-fired
